depiction.primary_object: five-pointed star solid on left, outlined on right
depiction.composition: single symmetrical star, front view, split vertically into solid and hollow halves

ambiguity: At small list-icon sizes it looks almost identical to a standard solid star (favorite/important) or a decorative nautical star.

modifier_semantics.meaning: partial rating (half star) or scoring scale

task_intents: submit a restaurant or hotel review

reasoning: The half-filled five-pointed star is the standard visual convention for ratings and reviews (such as a 3.5-star score on Yelp, Goodreads, or an app store). It fits tasks centered on writing reviews, rating media or purchases, and auditing customer feedback, though at small sizes it can easily blend in with a plain favorite/bookmark star.
